note: Lobby speech-bubble lines, 2-3 per hero (home screen). Short: two lines in a 500 px bubble at 24 px.
notice_note: What the Lobby heroine notices about a visit, once each (Game.notices, home_screen.gd _welcome_back): {h} hours, {hour} the hour.

notice.tz_ahead: Your clock jumped {h} hours. Where did you take me?
notice.tz_behind: You lost {h} hours somewhere. I'll help you find them.
notice.late: It's past {hour}. You should be asleep. ...Stay a minute.
notice.early: You're up before the sun. So am I, now.
notice.visits: Ten times today. I'm starting to think you like me.

team_note: Now and then (one visit in four, by the minute) the Lobby heroine says where she stands in the team: lead (slot 01), benched (not in it), by faction.

lead.celestial: Front and centre. I like it here.
lead.infernal: First in line. Where I belong.
lead.fallen: You put me first. Nobody does that.

benched.celestial: You never take me to the front. I'm not fragile.
benched.infernal: Benched? Bold of you. I'll remember it.
benched.fallen: Leave me out again. See if I wait.

pulse_note: Her line after a long hold on her (the heartbeat, home_screen.gd): what she says when the thumb finally lifts.
pulse: ...You can let go now. Or don't.
That's not where my heart is. Close enough.
It only does that when you're here.
Now you know. Don't tell anyone.
fallback: The sanctum is quiet tonight. Stay a while.

seraphiel: Hush. Listen... the sky still hums when you are near.
Every hymn I sing tonight is for you alone. Stay for the last note.
Come closer, envoy. Light is warmer when it is shared.
cassiel: Eyes up here, envoy. Well... eventually.
Nothing gets past my shield. You, I might let through.
I never take a step back. So you take one toward me.
liora: Did you get hurt? Let me sing it better... slowly.
I practiced a new song just for you. Promise you won't laugh?
My hands are warm, see? Healing works best up close.
uriela: Point me at the enemy and watch me shine.
The old stories say I can't be beaten. Shall we make them true?
You keep staring at my spear. It's fine. Everyone does.
nuriel: ...You didn't hear me come in. Good.
Dawn is my hour. Spend it with me.
I don't talk much. Stay anyway.
argentiel: Undefeated, envoy. Care to be my first loss?
Look all you like. Chrome doesn't blush. I might.
Stand at my side. It's the safest place in heaven.
sanariel: Hold still, envoy. This won't hurt... much.
Your pulse just jumped. Was that me?
Doctor's orders: stay close and let me fuss over you.
rimelle: The judges give me tens. What do you give me?
Careful on the ice, envoy. I might not let go.
Cold? Come closer. For you, I'll make an exception.
avienne: Eyes forward, please. Or don't. I won't tell.
Welcome aboard, envoy. Anything I can bring you?
Turbulence ahead. Hold on to me, not the armrest.
cirella: Stuck the landing! Your turn to impress me.
Front-row seat for my floor routine? Just for you.
Stretch with me, envoy. I'll go easy on you.
ferrael: Forged you a halo. Kidding! Unless you want one?
Mind the sparks! ...Or stay. I like the company.
The hammer's heavy, hugs are free. Pick one.
verdelle: You're wilting, envoy. Come sit in the sun with me.
Plants grow faster when you talk to them. So do I.
Did you eat your greens? I'll check, you know.
isobel: Feel that? The air's charged. Or is that just you?
I chase storms, envoy. You're the best one yet.
Hold my hand. The sky's about to get exciting.
halcia: Jump with me. I'll open my wings... eventually.
My heart's racing. That usually takes forty thousand feet.
Ever fallen for someone at terminal velocity?
mordessa: Kneel if you like, darling. I do enjoy the view.
I lost a war. I have no intention of losing you.
Keep my furnace fed and I'll keep you warm.
brakka: Brakka guards you. Brakka also guards the snacks.
Hide is hard. Heart is soft. Don't tell the Queen.
You fed Brakka once. Now Brakka follows you forever.
vesper: The ash says you'll stay a little longer. The ash is never wrong.
I read your future, sweet thing. It runs very hot.
Sit with me. I'll whisper what the embers say about you.
imra: A deal! Your smile for my luck. Fair-ish, I promise.
Sign here, here and... there. Kidding! Mostly.
Every pact needs a witness. Lucky you, it's me.
kessa: Twelve trophies. You'd make a lovely thirteenth page.
Relax, envoy. I only purr for people I like.
Got a contract for me? Or did you just want to look?
drezza: This next track is for you. Stay on the floor with me.
Feel that bass? That's my heart. Okay, it's the subwoofer.
I never stop the music. Give me a reason to slow it down.
zecchina: The house always wins, darling. Tonight the house wants you.
Every debt in hell is in my ledger. Yours, I might forgive.
Cut the deck, envoy. Let's see what you're willing to lose.
torqua: Smile for the cameras, envoy. Then smile just for me.
The pit lane is closed. My parasol is big enough for two.
A thousand photo calls, and you're the first to make me blush.
sigilla: Hold still. I'm deciding where my name goes on you.
Every curse I ink comes true. Want to see the one about you?
No appointment? For you, I'll stay open late.
carmesa: Charge at me all you like, envoy. I never miss my moment.
I bow before every kill. For you, I'd bow just to be watched.
The cape is red so you watch it. You're watching something else.
thrasha: Front row, envoy. Always. That's an order.
I wrote a song about you. It's loud and it's mostly screaming.
Banned from every venue in hell. Not from your room, right?
kindra: I keep every fire where it belongs. You're running a little hot.
Stop, drop and look at me. Fire safety, envoy.
I've carried a hundred demons out of fires. You, I'd carry slowly.
cordia: Your usual, envoy? I started pouring when you walked in.
Pull up a stool. Nobody in hell listens better than me.
Last call is whenever I say it is. Stay.
noctaire: I cut my wings over one refusal. Don't make me regret the rest.
Stand close. My blade knows whom to spare.
Heaven gave me orders. You only ever ask. I like that.
orrin: My oath outlived its gate. It found you instead.
Lean on me. These chains have held worse.
Rest. I'll keep watch until the last star goes out.
sable: Confess something to me, envoy. I'll keep it... mostly.
The ghosts come every week. You could come more often.
Light a candle with me. The dark is kinder in pairs.
lucen: One wing white, one wing black. Both of them like you.
I haven't picked a side yet. I might pick you.
En garde! ...No? Then dance with me instead.
ashra: Stand back a little. Or don't. I'm careful now. Mostly.
I burned one heaven by accident. You, I'd warm on purpose.
Fire is just attention you can see.
nadira: I lost the whole sky's signal. Yours still comes through clear.
Stay on the line, envoy. The static gets lonely.
Say it again, slower. I want to hear you without the delay.
gantra: The arm says you're cute. The arm has terrible taste. Usually.
Get behind me, envoy. Closer. Closer than that.
Last pilot of the fleet, and the cockpit seats two. Interested?
severine: They call me masterless. Care to apply for the job?
You're staring at the blade. Most people see the smile first.
Hold still, envoy. I only cut what I mean to.
benthe: Mm... it's quiet down deep. You'd like it there. Stay.
I don't move for anyone. I'll scoot over for you.
Lean on me, envoy. I'm heavier than the whole sea.
seyra: The static showed me your face again. It keeps doing that.
I've seen how tonight ends. You'll want to stay for it.
Shh... I'm listening to your future. It runs very warm.
rivette: Everything stops for me, envoy. See? You stopped too.
Win this round and the drinks are on me. Lose? Still me.
Race you to the bar. Loser buys, winner gets a kiss.
vandra: Hold still. I want to tag you somewhere nobody else sees.
Rules are just walls nobody has painted yet.
You look like trouble, envoy. Finally, my type.
ombre: One shot, envoy. I'm still deciding where to spend it.
I always read the ending first. We turn out fine.
Don't mind me. I'm only watching you. Very closely.
